complaint_text: हमारे इलाके में मुख्य बाजार के पास पिछले चार दिनों से नगर निगम की कचरा गाड़ी नहीं आई है। सामुदायिक कूड़ेदान पूरी तरह भर चुका है और बदबू आ रही है।
translated_english: Municipal garbage truck has not arrived for 4 days near the main market. Community dustbin is completely overflowing with strong stench.

complaint_text: Karol Bagh market road pe kachra faila hua hai, cows aur stray dogs spread kar rahe hain. Market association request kar rahi hai immediate cleaning ke liye.
translated_english: Garbage is scattered all over Karol Bagh market road, strays spreading waste. Market association requests immediate cleaning.

complaint_text: Sanitation workers have not cleared the dhalao (waste depot) near Block 7 for 3 days. Overflow is spilling onto the pedestrian walkway.
translated_english: Sanitation workers have not cleared the waste depot near Block 7 for 3 days. Overflow spilling onto walkway.

complaint_text: मार्केट के प्रवेश द्वार पर कूड़े का ढेर लग गया है, नालियां जाम हो रही हैं और बारिश के कारण गंदा पानी सड़क पर भर रहा है।
translated_english: Garbage pile accumulated at market entrance, drains getting blocked and dirty water logging on the road due to rain.

complaint_text: Station road ke corner pe do street lights pichle ek hafte se completely band padi hain. Raat 8 baje ke baad poora stretch dark ho jata hai.
translated_english: Two streetlights on station road corner have been out for a week. Entire stretch becomes dark after 8 PM.

complaint_text: Complete blackout on Andheri West station road approach from SV Road junction. Over five sodium fixtures non-functional causing severe commuter safety hazard.
translated_english: Complete blackout on Andheri West station approach road. Over 5 fixtures non-functional causing severe safety hazard.

complaint_text: अंधेरी स्टेशन रस्त्यावरील पथदिवे अनेक दिवसांपासून बंद आहेत. महिलांना रात्री प्रवास करताना असुरक्षित वाटत आहे. दुरुस्ती त्वरित करावी.
translated_english: Streetlights on Andheri station road non-operational for several days. Women feel unsafe commuting at night. Repair urgently.

complaint_text: Tap water supplied this morning to residential blocks in 4th Cross is heavily turbid, muddy brown, and emits a strong foul sewage odor. Suspected sewer line cross-contamination.
translated_english: Tap water supplied to residential blocks in 4th Cross is muddy brown with sewage odor. Suspected sewer cross-contamination.

complaint_text: ಬೆಳ್ಳಂದೂರು 4ನೇ ಕ್ರಾಸ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ನಲ್ಲಿಯ ನೀರು ಕಲುಷಿತವಾಗಿದ್ದು ಕೆಟ್ಟ ವಾಸನೆ ಬರುತ್ತಿದೆ. ಕುಡಿಯಲು ಯೋಗ್ಯವಾಗಿಲ್ಲ. ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ವಾಂತಿ ಭೇದಿ ಆರಂಭವಾಗಿದೆ.
translated_english: Tap water in Bellandur 4th cross is contaminated and smells foul. Not fit for drinking. Children developing sickness.

complaint_text: Bellandur 4th Cross apartment complex me BWSSB supply water totally black/brown aa raha hai sewage mix lag raha hai. Kindly test water quality immediately.
translated_english: In Bellandur 4th Cross apartment supply water is black/brown with sewage mix. Kindly test water quality immediately.

complaint_text: Main pipeline burst ho gayi hai near circle number 3. Clean drinking water road pe waste ho raha hai aur houses mein pressure zero ho chuka hai.
translated_english: Main pipeline has burst near circle 3. Clean drinking water wasting on road and residential pressure zero.

complaint_text: జూబ్లీ హిల్స్ సర్కిల్ 3 వద్ద ప్రధాన తాగునీటి పైప్‌లైన్ పగిలి రోడ్డుపై నీరు వరదలా ప్రవహిస్తోంది. మా కాలనీలో నీటి సరఫరా పూర్తిగా నిలిచిపోయింది.
translated_english: Main drinking water pipeline broke at Jubilee Hills Circle 3 flooding road. Colony water supply completely halted.

complaint_text: Road subsidence occurring outside Circle 3 due to continuous pressurized water line leak. Commuter traffic is diverted.
translated_english: Road subsidence outside Circle 3 due to water pipeline leak. Traffic diverted.

complaint_text: Streetlight mast pole near government school has exposed live copper wires hanging loose at child height following thunderstorm.
translated_english: Streetlight pole near school has exposed live wires hanging at child height following thunderstorm.

complaint_text: বালিগঞ্জ সরকারি স্কুলের পাশের ল্যাম্পপোস্ট থেকে বিদ্যুতের খোলা তার ঝুলছে। বৃষ্টিতে মারাত্মক বিপদের আশঙ্কা রয়েছে।
translated_english: Open electric wire hanging from lamppost next to Ballygunge government school. Danger of severe electrocution in rain.

complaint_text: Commercial market dustbin overflowing for three days with plastic and food waste attracting rodents.
translated_english: Commercial dustbin overflowing for 3 days attracting pests.

complaint_text: अस्पताल के निकट मुख्य मार्ग पर खुला कचरा डंप पड़ा हुआ है। तेज बदबू और संक्रमण का भारी खतरा उत्पन्न हो गया है।
translated_english: Open garbage dump near hospital main road creating foul smell and infection risk.

complaint_text: Residential lane me morning door-to-door waste collection vehicle 20 minute late aati hai, timing regularize karwayein.
translated_english: Door-to-door waste vehicle arriving 20 minutes late, please regularize timing.

complaint_text: தெரு முனையில் குப்பை தொட்டி நிரம்பி வழிகிறது. துர்நாற்றம் தாங்க முடியவில்லை, உடனே அகற்ற வேண்டும்.
translated_english: Street corner garbage bin is overflowing with unbearable stench, remove immediately.

complaint_text: શાકભાજી માર્કેટ પાસે કચરાનો મોટો ઢગલો થયો છે, મ્યુનિસિપલ કચરા ગાડી મોકલીને તુરંત સફાઈ કરાવો.
translated_english: Huge garbage pile near vegetable market, send municipal truck for immediate cleanup.

complaint_text: Drinking water pipeline damaged during fiber optic road digging. Massive clean water leakage and zero pressure in nearby residences.
translated_english: Drinking water pipe damaged during road digging causing massive leak and zero pressure.

complaint_text: पिछले दो दिनों से सुबह के समय नलों में बहुत कम दबाव से पानी आ रहा है। ऊपरी मंजिलों पर पानी नहीं चढ़ पा रहा है।
translated_english: Very low water pressure during morning supply for 2 days; water not reaching upper floors.

complaint_text: Society tap water me dirty black drainage water mix hoke aa raha hai. Drinking purpose ke liye bilkul unsafe hai.
translated_english: Drainage water mixed with society tap water, completely unsafe for drinking.

complaint_text: కాలనీలోని పబ్లిక్ వాటర్ ట్యాప్ వద్ద చిన్నపాటి లీకేజీ ఉంది. నీటి వృధాను అరికట్టడానికి మరమ్మతు చేయండి.
translated_english: Minor leakage at public water tap in the colony, repair to prevent water wastage.

complaint_text: പ്രധാന കുടിവെള്ള പൈപ്പ് പൊട്ടി റോഡിൽ വെള്ളക്കെട്ടുണ്ടായി. ശുദ്ധജല വിതരണം പൂർണ്ണമായും നിലച്ചു.
translated_english: Main drinking water pipe burst creating road flood. Water supply fully stopped.

complaint_text: Four consecutive streetlights on main bus route are completely dark for the past 5 days causing pedestrian hazard.
translated_english: Four consecutive streetlights dark on main bus route for 5 days.

complaint_text: बिजली के खंभे का फ्यूज बॉक्स खुला हुआ है और जमीन से एक मीटर ऊपर नंगे तार लटक रहे हैं। बच्चों के लिए बहुत खतरनाक है।
translated_english: Open fuse box on electric pole with exposed wires one meter above ground. Extreme hazard for children.

complaint_text: Lane 3 me ek streetlight continuously blink/flicker kar rahi hai. Bulb replace karne ki request hai.
translated_english: One streetlight in Lane 3 continuously flickering, request bulb replacement.

complaint_text: కాలనీలోని పబ్లిక్ వాటర్ ట్యాప్ వద్ద చిన్నపాటి లీకేజీ ఉంది. నీటి వృధాను అరికట్టడానికి మరమ్మతు చేయండి.
translated_english: Minor leakage at public water tap in the colony, repair to prevent water wastage.

complaint_text: പ്രധാന കുടിവെള്ള പൈപ്പ് പൊട്ടി റോഡിൽ വെള്ളക്കെട്ടുണ്ടായി. ശുദ്ധജല വിതരണം പൂർണ്ണമായും നിലച്ചു.
translated_english: Main drinking water pipe burst creating road flood. Water supply fully stopped.

complaint_text: Four consecutive streetlights on main bus route are completely dark for the past 5 days causing pedestrian hazard.
translated_english: Four consecutive streetlights dark on main bus route for 5 days.

complaint_text: बिजली के खंभे का फ्यूज बॉक्स खुला हुआ है और जमीन से एक मीटर ऊपर नंगे तार लटक रहे हैं। बच्चों के लिए बहुत खतरनाक है।
translated_english: Open fuse box on electric pole with exposed wires one meter above ground. Extreme hazard for children.

complaint_text: Lane 3 me ek streetlight continuously blink/flicker kar rahi hai. Bulb replace karne ki request hai.
translated_english: One streetlight in Lane 3 continuously flickering, request bulb replacement.

complaint_text: বাস স্ট্যান্ডের মোড়ে ৩টি স্ট্রিট লাইট জ্বলছে না। সন্ধ্যার পর রাস্তা অন্ধকার হয়ে যায়, দুর্ঘটনার ঝুঁকি রয়েছে।
translated_english: 3 streetlights not working at bus stand corner. Road dark after evening with accident risk.

complaint_text: ਮੁੱਖ ਸੜਕ ਦੇ ਖੰਭੇ ਤੋਂ ਤਾਰਾਂ ਹੇਠਾਂ ਲਟਕ ਰਹੀਆਂ ਹਨ ਅਤੇ ਮੀਂਹ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰੰਟ ਆਉਣ ਦਾ ਖਤਰਾ ਹੈ। ਤੁਰੰਤ ਟੀਮ ਭੇਜੋ।
translated_english: Wires hanging down from main road pole with electrocution risk during rain. Send team immediately.

complaint_text: Commercial market dustbin overflowing for three days with plastic and food waste attracting rodents.
translated_english: Commercial dustbin overflowing for 3 days attracting pests.

complaint_text: अस्पताल के निकट मुख्य मार्ग पर खुला कचरा डंप पड़ा हुआ है। तेज बदबू और संक्रमण का भारी खतरा उत्पन्न हो गया है।
translated_english: Open garbage dump near hospital main road creating foul smell and infection risk.

complaint_text: Residential lane me morning door-to-door waste collection vehicle 20 minute late aati hai, timing regularize karwayein.
translated_english: Door-to-door waste vehicle arriving 20 minutes late, please regularize timing.

complaint_text: தெரு முனையில் குப்பை தொட்டி நிரம்பி வழிகிறது. துர்நாற்றம் தாங்க முடியவில்லை, உடனே அகற்ற வேண்டும்.
translated_english: Street corner garbage bin is overflowing with unbearable stench, remove immediately.

complaint_text: શાકભાજી માર્કેટ પાસે કચરાનો મોટો ઢગલો થયો છે, મ્યુનિસિપલ કચરા ગાડી મોકલીને તુરંત સફાઈ કરાવો.
translated_english: Huge garbage pile near vegetable market, send municipal truck for immediate cleanup.

complaint_text: Drinking water pipeline damaged during fiber optic road digging. Massive clean water leakage and zero pressure in nearby residences.
translated_english: Drinking water pipe damaged during road digging causing massive leak and zero pressure.

complaint_text: पिछले दो दिनों से सुबह के समय नलों में बहुत कम दबाव से पानी आ रहा है। ऊपरी मंजिलों पर पानी नहीं चढ़ पा रहा है।
translated_english: Very low water pressure during morning supply for 2 days; water not reaching upper floors.
